# AdScanVideo

> AI video analysis for creators, editors, and marketers.

AdScanVideo accepts video uploads (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV) and public video links.
Videos must be at most 10 minutes and uploads at most 200 MB. Some platforms
restrict downloads; uploading a file is the alternative.

## Analysis modes
- Shot breakdown, including creative cinematic prompts
- Ad intelligence
- Podcast notes
- Marketing copy
- Tutorial steps
- Summary

Analysis uses sampled video frames. Spoken quotes require available captions;
without a transcript the result is visual-only. AI output should be reviewed.

## Pricing
One free analysis per day per network, resetting at midnight UTC. Failed analyses
restore the allowance. Additional analysis credits are planned at USD $0.50 each;
payments are not available yet. The planned $19/month subscription is not launched.
